semanticOwner: The profile's canonical FWConfig Backup marker-relative locators remain the only declaration of where an NVT marker counts; FirmwareFamilyResolutionDefinition.ResolveNvtEndFlag (ResolvedFirmwareImageMap.NvtEndFlagResolution) is their single projection, FirmwareNvtEndFlagMigration the single named inventory of families allowed to resolve without a declaration, and BuiltInFirmwareInspection.ResolveCtrlRamBaseNvtEndFlag the single IC-level projection for a Base before map selection; FirmwareConfigMetadataReader remains the only reader of the canonical Backup; FirmwareArtifactClassificationResolver (AB-TWO-NVT-1112-01), the CompositionRunService final-output evaluators (CTRLRAM-OSD-ENVELOPE-1112-01), FirmwareConfigChipCountDiagnostics/AbMergeTopologyAdmission and CompiledInputArtifactObservationService remain the owners of their decisions and only pass the resolved declaration.
terminalContract: Owner decisions 30, 35 and 37; proposed ADR 0076 amends ADR 0015/0016. A layout declares its NVT end flag when every canonical FWConfig Backup NVT (00 4E 56 54) marker-relative locator its map selects has a search range exactly the marker length, at one position, unique selection and result offset -0xFFC; a map declaring it for only some locators, or at different positions, is rejected when the family is built. Where declared, only the marker at that position locates the Backup; a complete marker anywhere else is neither counted nor rejected. Resolution either succeeds or fails: it succeeds without a declaration only for a family in the named migration inventory FirmwareNvtEndFlagMigration, whose readers keep their existing template locators and the existing compatibility-reader behavior, unchanged and not newly authorized (the two already differ in range); a missing, inconsistent or unavailable declaration fails, and the reader then reports the Backup unreadable and never searches the whole image. Declarations: every NT51950/NT51951 layout that reads the marker declares flash [0x36FFC,0x37000) (TP section end minus 4, Backup start 0x36000): the shared dp-perspective Standard/DP Replace/General Merge family (TP input and retired DP Replace Reference locators), the 950/951 CtrlRAM Replace families, and the AB family through one new metadata set for the TP A and TP B inputs in TP-input coordinates, which equal each bank's bank-local coordinates. Uses, each through the declaration of the layout it works with: CtrlRAM Base AB evidence reads each bank at the AB layout's bank-local end flag (NT51950 0x36FFC and 0x76FFC, NT51951 1 MiB 0x36FFC and 0xB6FFC); the Standard Base event-buffer read uses the exact Standard layout or the one declaration shared by every consensus layout, and skips the read for no candidate, disagreement or failure; FWConfig Backup version, placement-authority (output and immutable Reference) and expected-address validations use the validated, or bank-local, composition; Reference and TP A/B observations, AB T-token naming and TP-input IC Count admission use their composition, several AB candidates their shared declaration; CtrlRAM admission and firmware inspection of a Base (IC Count, postbuild selection, TP FW version edit, display, context suggestion) use the declaration every CtrlRAM Replace map of the IC shares. The named reader inventory (RepositoryBoundaryTests.NvtEndFlagCallers) is exactly these six production files, all reading through a declaration. Map resolution: the trusted profile-selective paths resolve only a profile's required structures, so AB profile map resolution is unchanged; the generic public ResolveMap(inputs) resolves every selected structure, so with TP A/B inputs it now also requires each input's end-flag marker (no match otherwise) and without them stays pending as before, and for the narrowed dp-perspective and CtrlRAM maps it requires the end-flag marker of each supplied bound artifact; no production code calls it. Migration and retirement: the inventory lists the ten pending runtime families - nt51917-nt51927-nt51928-canonical-container, nt51923-nt51926 and the NT51923/926/927/928 CtrlRAM families (later small R3 item of decision 35), nt51929-nt51932, the NT51929/932 CtrlRAM families and nt51919-nt51929-nt51932-ab-merge (later count-derived item); tests require every NT51950/NT51951 use to obtain a declaration, the inventory to equal exactly the built-in families that resolve without one, no built-in layout to fail, the reader inventory to stay as named, and, once the inventory is empty, the compatibility state and the no-declaration reader overloads to be deleted in the same batch. Every AB-TWO-NVT-1112-01 term other than the marker position and every CTRLRAM-OSD-ENVELOPE-1112-01 term other than which marker is read are unchanged; operator messages keep the SPEC text. Consequences and accepted risks: a Display OSD marker away from the end flag no longer makes a 512 KiB NT51950 Standard Base AB or a captured envelope Build fail; an NT51950/NT51951 Base, TP input, bank or output whose end flag lacks the marker is rejected for the same reason as one without any marker, even when a marker exists elsewhere; an OSD-half marker exactly at 0x76FFC of a 512 KiB NT51950 Standard Base is B-bank evidence by rule, so that Base is AB with an invalid B bank (owner-accepted boundary, pinned by a test). The four family changes re-pin family, profile, bundle and trust-index hashes, the 23 NT51950/NT51951 route capability fingerprints in the canonical capability policy and the canonical Golden manifest, and the runtime policy digest; persisted state bound to old fingerprints becomes stale, and saved General Merge rules bound to the previous NT51950/NT51951 family identity no longer admit (owner-accepted, decision 37; General Merge is hidden and will be re-implemented). The release projections (scripts/package.ps1, scripts/smoke-release.ps1, tests/scripts/test_release_package_policy.py) re-pin the policy and trust-index digests only under the disjoint companion NVT-END-FLAG-RELEASE-PIN-1113-01. No output byte, write range, operation order, CRC/header, padding, truncation, naming or expected Golden byte changes. Evidence: the two flipped fail-closed regressions; end-flag-missing negatives for Base and envelope that fail with the same issue codes as a Base without any marker and no bank-reference code; off-end-flag acceptance and end-flag-missing rejection for the 950/951 Standard Merge TP input and AB TP A/B inputs with their existing issue codes, metadata and marker count and complete outputs; the retired DP Replace declared locator through metadata resolution (resolved at 0x36FFC with count 1 beside an extra marker, MarkerCardinalityMismatch with count 0 when only a misplaced marker exists) plus the unchanged retirement refusal; exact, consensus, missing and inconsistent event-buffer declarations; the accepted 0x76FFC boundary; declaration, inventory, retirement and reader-inventory tests; a fresh catalog load, all six AB maps and metadata-plan creation regression; execution of every applicable certified NT51950/NT51951 Golden output case (the 11 canonical cases) with unchanged expected bytes and SHA-256, the marker scan being auxiliary only; and two exact-final-evidence-head owner attestations: firmware-owner for this record and release-owner for NVT-END-FLAG-RELEASE-PIN-1113-01.
